subject: Ledger lockstep & weekly invoice lane — PO header requirements
messages:
From: Angela Murray <angela.murray@starlit.health>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Starlit Health Procurement <procurement@starlit.health>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ledger lockstep & weekly invoice lane — PO header requirements

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the productive call yesterday. Procurement needs a bit more clarity before we can issue the blanket PO for the pilot. Two asks from our side:  

1) PO header fields: our AP system requires a PO that contains the following explicit fields in the header for automated matching — Vendor legal name, Redwood billing entity (if different than vendor), Tax ID / VAT, Billing remit address, Primary contact email, and GL code mapping. Can you confirm Redwood will accept that header verbatim on the PO?

2) Invoice cadence: Starlit prefers a weekly invoice lane (every Friday) that pulls the prior week’s usage. We understand most vendors do monthly billing — can Redwood support weekly invoicing with line-level detail (separate lines for Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, and Support), and will you provide an invoice CSV file suitable for our ERPs?

I've attached our PO template for reference (starlit_PO_template.xlsx). If you need any of the fields renamed to conform to your internal accounting, let me know and we'll send a signed PO once we get confirmation.

Also: our default terms are NET45; we will include that on the PO unless you confirm a different standard.

Best,

Angela Murray
Procurement Manager
Starlit Health
procurement@starlit.health
(555) 712-4820

Attachment: starlit_PO_template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Angela Murray <angela.murray@starlit.health>
Cc: Starlit Health Procurement <procurement@starlit.health>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ledger lockstep & weekly invoice lane — PO header requirements

Hi Angela — thanks for sending the template and the clear list. We can accommodate your requirements, here are the specifics and constraints from our side:  

• PO header fields: we can accept the header fields verbatim. Please make sure the PO references the Redwood billing entity as "Redwood Inference, Inc." (legal name) and includes our Tax ID: 81-3456789. For ERP matching we require the PO number and a billing contact (email) to be present; if those map to different fields in your template, we can accept them in the header or a dedicated PO line.

• Weekly invoices: we support weekly invoice lanes for enterprise customers on reserved/enterprise billing. We will generate a consolidated PDF invoice plus a machine-readable CSV export that includes per-line usage (Hosted API calls / Embeddings, Dedicated capacity hours, and Support/Professional services line items). Invoices will be sent to the remit email you designate and to accounts-payable@redwoodinference.com.

• Terms: NET45 is fine for this deal; we'll accept NET45 as noted on the PO. We will apply standard SLA credit rules if incidents trigger credits (we include a line on invoices showing any credits applied).

Operational notes: weekly billing increases bookkeeping on both sides; for weekly lanes we require a minimum activation notice of one full billing cycle (we need at least one week after PO receipt to seed billing). If usage spikes > 3x forecast we reserve the right to move to a centralized weekly-to-monthly reconciliation cadence for that period.

Next steps: please send a signed PO referencing Master Service Agreement ID MSA-2027-041 and include the line mappings you want on the PO. Vanessa (cc'd) will coordinate the billing setup and send our weekly invoice spec (CSV column definitions) so you can confirm mapping.

Happy to hop on a quick call if it's easier.

Thanks,

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Angela Murray <angela.murray@starlit.health>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Starlit Health Procurement <procurement@starlit.health>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ledger lockstep & weekly invoice lane — PO header requirements

Hi Angela — Vanessa here from the accounts team, following up with the quick spec and request list so we can set up the weekly lane without surprises.  

1) I attached our weekly invoice spec (weekly_invoice_spec.pdf) — it shows the CSV columns we export: invoice_date, invoice_id, po_number, gl_code, line_description, quantity, unit_price, line_total, usage_start, usage_end, credit_amount, net_due_date. Can you confirm your AP can ingest a CSV with these columns?

2) When you send the signed PO, please include: PO number, billing entity on the header (Redwood Inference, Inc.), remit_to email (accounts-payable@redwoodinference.com), and the GL mapping if you require a specific mapping; otherwise we’ll default to the standard Redwood GL for SaaS subscriptions.

3) ACH / wire details: we will include our ACH instructions on the invoice footer. If Starlit needs a separate vendor setup form filled, we can complete that after PO receipt — just send the document and we’ll fill it within 2 business days.

Operational constraint worth flagging: for weekly invoices we require a minimum invoice amount threshold of $2,000 per invoice (to avoid micro-invoices). If weekly usage would generate invoices below $2k, we default to monthly aggregation unless you prefer multiple weekly invoices with a roll-up monthly statement.

If the PO includes a clause for weekly invoicing and NET45, we’re good to proceed. Once we have the signed file we’ll provision the weekly lane and schedule the first invoice for the Friday following activation week.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the signed PO and will send the vendor onboarding form if you need it filled.

Regards,

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: weekly_invoice_spec.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Angela Murray <angela.murray@starlit.health>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Starlit Health Procurement <procurement@starlit.health>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Ledger lockstep & weekly invoice lane — PO header requirements

Vivek / Vanessa — thanks, this all looks good and actionable. Per your notes we will:  

• Sign and return the PO using your legal name Redwood Inference, Inc., include PO#: STL-PO-45021, and state NET45 and reference MSA-2027-041.
• Include the GL mappings for API vs Dedicated vs Support in the PO line notes so the CSV reconciliation will match.
• Accept the $2,000 minimum per weekly invoice; Starlit will request monthly aggregation if usage stays below that threshold.

I attached the signed PO (STL-PO-45021.pdf). Please confirm the remit email accounts-payable@redwoodinference.com and the ACH details (or a secure link to vendor bank instructions) so we can complete vendor setup on our side. Also confirm the first invoice date (we want the first Friday after activation).

Appreciate the quick turn — look forward to kicking off the pilot.

Best,

Angela Murray
Procurement Manager
Starlit Health

Attachment: STL-PO-45021.pdf (signed PO, 1 page)
